  select case when position('@' in e) > 0 then left(e, 1) || '***@' || split_part(e, '@', 2) else '***@' || e end
$$;

create or replace function public.phone_masked(p text)
returns text
language sql
immutable
as $$
  select case when length(p) > 4 then '******' || right(p, 4) else '******' end
